goal: First real-input interpretable primary health HMM and auxiliary supervised anomaly evidence, not a physical 3-state diagnosis
real_data: OPS-SAT-AD original raw segments, train=1 ONLY, 9 independent single-channel groups, source https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.12588359
fixed_truth: Genuine published normal/anomaly label per entire segment; no true sub-window anomaly onset and no independently confirmed physical health/degraded/fault or expert health scores

split.unit: blocks of consecutive 16 same-channel segment IDs, not asserted physical UTC across segments
split.remaining_split: divide remaining groups into HMM_aux_fit_compatible_fusion,calibration,holdout via group split: 45%/25%/30% within remainder
split.separate_test: Internal blocked segment holdout; historically observed same dataset, never first blind

prefix_window.semantics: use only past 16 raw samples for each inference tick, reset at each segment; segment onset unknown
prefix_window.point_label_usage: NO subwindow true labels; inherit segment label only for grouped auxiliary training, never report point-wise F1
prefix_window.per_channel_normal_reference: fit historical nominal windows only, robust median and MAD of mean and log(std)

initialization.semantics: engineering-defined relative nominal deviation, NOT physical faults
initialization.risk_score: sqrt( zmean^2 + zlogstd^2 ), z normalized using fitted nominal per-channel median / robust MAD
initialization.softening: softmax closeness to class quantile anchor centers determined from nominal train, bounded minimum temperature

hmm.transition: only consecutive weak-state windows WITHIN each historical fit segment; add0.5 pseudocount; reset at every segment
hmm.mode: causal forward filter, posterior/as-if-likelihood class prior correction

auxiliary.fit: historical fit windows (max up to12 windows per segment to reduce unequal segment weights)

fusion.estimator: multinomial logistic(C=.5) trained on distinct fusion phase, using HMM state log-probs and auxiliary anomaly logit
fusion.target: published binary segment anomaly (normal/anomaly); NOT 3-class physical states
fusion.output_semantics: post-fusion anomaly probability is auxiliary-objective risk measure, not directly a new P(physical 3state)

final_health_score.role: mapping after fused evidence; maintain raw model anomaly alarm independently
final_health_score.correction: a fused-evidence-aware display risk adjustment must be PREDEFINED for study; final display score mapping only after all evidence
final_health_score.calibrator: constrained ordered mapping fitting needs authenticated human scores and disjoint acceptance; may implement API but cannot assess empirical score MAE
final_health_score.guarantee: rating change cannot change objective anomaly p or alarm; version/baseline hash

evaluation.unit: one segment: evaluate last causal subwindow output against true official segment binary label
measures: Brier for supervised anomaly probability ONLY
evaluation.disclaimer: static tier risk cannot be interpreted as calibrated objective P(anomaly): no Brier vs objective label
evaluation.accept: Exploratory result only, because dataset audited many times and segment labels do not annotate state-transition onset
evaluation.failure_report: if no incremental gain, report full metrics and do not claim fusion improves diagnosis

forbidden: label a2/a3/a4 as three ordinal physical states
string different segments into groundtruth Markov sequences
evaluate sampled windows as independent labels
claim expert score matching without expert data
